The stage residence time of the columns is generally designed to be short, at 30 seconds or less.

text.zh: 为使用化学交换过程的铀浓缩工厂而专门设计或制造的液－液离心接触器。此类接触器利用转动来达到有机相与水相的分散，然后借助离心力来分离开这两相。为了耐浓盐酸溶液的腐蚀，这些接触器一般用适当的塑料（例如碳氟聚合物）或玻璃来制造或保护。离心接触器的级停留时间被设计得很短（30 秒或更短）。
text.en: Liquid-liquid centrifugal contactors specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process. These contactors use rotation to disperse the organic and aqueous phases and then use centrifugal force to separate them. To resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions, these contactors are generally made of or protected by suitable plastics, such as fluorocarbon polymers, or glass. The stage residence time of the centrifugal contactors is designed to be short, at 30 seconds or less.

text.zh: 电化学还原槽
text.en: Electrochemical reduction cells

text.zh: 该设备是为使用化学交换过程的铀浓缩工厂专门设计或制造的，用来将铀从一种价态还原为另一种价态的。与过程溶液接触的这种槽的材料必须能耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀。这种槽的阴极室必须设计成能防止铀被再氧化到较高的价态。为了把铀保持在阴极室中，这种槽可有一个由特种阳离子交换材料制成的抗渗的隔膜。阴极一般由石墨之类适宜的固态导体组成。
text.en: This equipment is specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process, to reduce uranium from one valence state to another. Cell materials in contact with process solutions must resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions. The cathode compartment must be designed to prevent uranium from being reoxidized to a higher valence state. To retain uranium in the cathode compartment, the cell may have an impervious diaphragm made of special cation-exchange material. The cathode generally consists of a suitable solid conductor such as graphite.

text.zh: 装在级联的产品端为将有机相流中的 U⁺⁴ 移出、调节酸浓度和向电化学还原槽供料而专门设计或制造的系统
text.en: Systems installed at the product end of the cascade and specially designed or manufactured to remove U⁺⁴ from the organic stream, adjust acid concentration and feed the electrochemical reduction cells

text.zh: 这些系统由以下设备组成：将有机相流中的 U⁺⁴ 反萃取到水溶液中的溶剂萃取设备，完成溶液 pH 值调节和控制的蒸发设备和（或）其他设备，以及向电化学还原槽供料的泵或其他输送装置。一个重要的设计问题是要避免水相流被某些种类的金属离子沾污。因此，对该系统那些接触这种过程物流的部分，要用适当的材料（例如玻璃、碳氟聚合物、聚苯硫酸酯、聚醚砜和用树脂浸过的石墨）制成或保护的设备来构成。
text.en: These systems consist of solvent extraction equipment for stripping U⁺⁴ from the organic stream into an aqueous solution, evaporation and/or other equipment for adjusting and controlling solution pH, and pumps or other transfer devices for feeding the electrochemical reduction cells. An important design consideration is avoiding contamination of the aqueous stream by certain types of metal ions. Therefore, the parts of the system in contact with these process streams must comprise equipment made of or protected by suitable materials, such as glass, fluorocarbon polymers, polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide], polyether sulfone, or resin-impregnated graphite.

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的用来为化学交换铀同位素分离工厂生产高纯氯化铀供料溶液的系统。这些系统由进行纯化所需的溶解设备、溶剂萃取设备和（或）离子交换设备，以及用来将 U⁺⁶ 或 U⁺⁴ 还原为 U⁺³ 的电解槽组成。这些系统产生只含几个 ppm的铬、铁、钒、钼和其他两价或价态更高的阳离子金属杂质的氯化铀溶液。处理高纯度 U⁺³ 系统的若干部分的建造材料包括玻璃、碳氟聚合物、聚苯硫酸酯或聚醚砜塑料衬里的石墨和用树脂浸过的石墨。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured to produce high-purity uranium chloride feed solutions for chemical-exchange uranium isotope separation plants. These systems consist of dissolution, solvent extraction and/or ion-exchange equipment for purification, and electrolytic cells for reducing U⁺⁶ or U⁺⁴ to U⁺³. These systems produce uranium chloride solutions containing only a few ppm of chromium, iron, vanadium, molybdenum and other metallic impurities that form divalent or higher-valence cations. Construction materials for certain parts of high-purity U⁺³ handling systems include glass, fluorocarbon polymers, graphite lined with polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide] or polyether sulfone plastic, and resin-impregnated graphite.

text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured to oxidize U⁺³ to U⁺⁴ for return to the uranium isotope separation cascade in the chemical-exchange enrichment process. These systems may incorporate: (a) Equipment for contacting chlorine and oxygen with the aqueous stream from isotope separation equipment, and for extracting the resulting U⁺⁴ into the stripped organic phase returning from the product end of the cascade; (b) Equipment for separating water from hydrochloric acid so that water and concentrated hydrochloric acid can be reintroduced at appropriate points in the process.

text.zh: 快速反应离子交换树脂/吸附剂（离子交换）
text.en: Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins/adsorbents (ion exchange)

text.zh: 为以离子交换过程进行铀浓缩而专门设计或制造的快速反应离子交换树脂或吸附剂包括：多孔大网络树脂，和（或）薄膜结构（在这些结构中，活性化学交换基团仅限于非活性多孔支持结构表面的一个涂层），以及处于包括颗粒或纤维在内的任何适宜形式的其他复合结构。这些离子交换树脂/吸附剂的直径有 0.2mm 或更小，而且在化学性质上必须能耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀，在物理性质上必须有足够的强度因而在交换柱中不被降解。这些树脂/吸附剂是专门为实现很快的铀同位素交换动力学过程（低于 10 秒的交换速率减半期）而设计的，并且能在 100-200℃的温度范围内操作。
text.en: Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins or adsorbents specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment by the ion-exchange process, including porous macroreticular resins and/or thin-film structures in which the active chemical exchange groups are limited to a coating on the surface of an inactive porous support structure, and other composite structures in any suitable form, including particles or fibers. These ion-exchange resins/adsorbents have diameters of 0.2 mm or less, must chemically resist concentrated hydrochloric acid, and must have sufficient physical strength to avoid degradation in the exchange columns. These resins/adsorbents are specially designed to achieve very rapid uranium-isotope exchange kinetics (an exchange-rate half-time below 10 seconds) and to operate at temperatures of 100–200 °C.

text.zh: 为以离子交换过程进行铀浓缩而专门设计或制造的用于容纳和支撑离子交换树脂/吸附剂填充床层的直径大于 1000mm的圆柱。这些柱一般用耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀的材料（例如钛或碳氟塑料）制成或保护，并能在 100-200℃的温度范围内和高于 0.7MPa（102psi）的压力下操作。
text.en: Cylindrical columns with diameters greater than 1000 mm, specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment by the ion-exchange process, for containing and supporting packed beds of ion-exchange resins/adsorbents. These columns are generally made of or protected by materials resistant to corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions, such as titanium or fluorocarbon plastics, and can operate at temperatures of 100–200 °C and pressures above 0.7 MPa (102 psi).

text.en: Ion-exchange reflux systems (ion exchange)

text.zh: （a）专门设计和制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学还原剂再生的化学或电化学还原系统。（b）专门设计或制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学氧化剂再生的化学或电化学氧化系统。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 Ti⁺³ 作为还原阳离子，在这种情况下，所用还原系统将通过还原 Ti⁺⁴ 使 Ti⁺³ 再生。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 Fe⁺³ 作为氧化剂，在这种情况下，所用氧化系统将通过氧化 Fe⁺² 来使 Fe⁺³ 再生。
text.en: (a) Chemical or electrochemical reduction systems specially designed and manufactured to regenerate the chemical reducing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. (b) Chemical or electrochemical oxidation systems specially designed or manufactured to regenerate the chemical oxidizing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. An ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, Ti⁺³ as the reducing cation; in that case, the reduction system regenerates Ti⁺³ by reducing Ti⁺⁴. An ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, Fe⁺³ as the oxidizing agent; in that case, the oxidation system regenerates Fe⁺³ by oxidizing Fe⁺².

text.zh:
专门设计或制造用于激光浓缩的熔融铀、熔融铀合金或铀金属蒸气处理系统，或为这些系统专门设计或制造的部件。
注释：液态金属铀处理系统可包括坩埚及其冷却设备。这种系统的坩埚和其他接触熔融铀、熔融铀合金或铀金属蒸气的部分，要用有适当的耐腐蚀和耐高温性能的材料制成或保护。适当的材料包括钽、氧化钇涂敷石墨、用其他稀土氧化物或其混合物涂敷的石墨。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured for handling molten uranium, molten uranium alloys or uranium metal vapor in laser enrichment, or components specially designed or manufactured for those systems. Explanatory Note: Liquid uranium metal handling systems may include crucibles and cooling equipment therefor. Crucibles and other parts of these systems in contact with molten uranium, molten uranium alloys or uranium metal vapor are made of or protected by materials with suitable corrosion resistance and high-temperature resistance. Suitable materials include tantalum, yttria-coated graphite, and graphite coated with other rare-earth oxides or mixtures thereof.

text.en: "Product" and "tails" collector assemblies specially designed or manufactured for collecting liquid or solid uranium metal. Components of these assemblies are made of or protected by materials resistant to the high temperatures and corrosion caused by uranium metal vapor or liquid, such as yttria-coated graphite or tantalum. These components may include pipes, valves, fittings, gutters, feedthroughs, heat exchangers and collector plates for magnetic, electrostatic or other separation methods.

text.zh: 氟化系统（MLIS）
text.en: Fluorination systems (MLIS)

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的用于将UF₅（固体）氟化为UF₆（气体）的系统。这些系统是为将所收集的UF₅粉末氟化为UF₆而设计的。其UF₆随后将被收集于产品容器中，或作为进料被转送到为进行进一步浓缩而设置的MLIS 单元中。在一种方案中，这种氟化反应可在同位素分离系统内部完成，以便一离开“产品”收集器便反应和回收。在另一种方案中，UF₅粉末将被从“产品”收集器中移出/转送到一个适当的反应容器（例如流化床反应器、螺旋反应器或火焰塔式反应器）中进行氟化。在这两种方案中，都使用氟气（或其他适宜的氟化剂）贮存和转送设备，以及UF₆收集和转送设备。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured for fluorinating UF₅ (solid) to UF₆ (gas). These systems are designed to fluorinate collected UF₅ powder to UF₆. The UF₆ is subsequently collected in product containers or transferred as feed to MLIS units for further enrichment. In one approach, this fluorination reaction may occur within the isotope-separation system, allowing reaction and recovery immediately after leaving the “product” collectors. In another approach, UF₅ powder is removed/transferred from the “product” collectors to a suitable reaction vessel, such as a fluidized-bed, screw, or flame-tower reactor, for fluorination. Both approaches use equipment for storing and transferring fluorine gas or other suitable fluorinating agents, and equipment for collecting and transferring UF₆.

text.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪/离子源（MLIS）
text.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources (MLIS)

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的质谱仪，这些质谱仪能从UF₆ 气流中“在线”取得样品，并且具有以下所有特点：
1.能够测量320 或更大原子质量单位的离子，且单位分辨率高于320；
2.离子源镍、含镍60%或以上（按重量计）的镍铜合金或镍铬合金制成或保护；
3.电子轰击离子源；
4.有一个适合于同位素分析的收集器系统。
text.en: Specially designed or prepared mass spectrometers capable of taking “on-line” samples from UF₆ gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater, with unit resolution better than 320; 2. Ion sources made of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or nickel-chromium alloys; 3. Electron-bombardment ion sources; 4. A collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

text.zh: 激光系统 （ AVLIS ， MLIS 和CRISLA）
text.en: Laser systems (AVLIS, MLIS and CRISLA)

text.zh: 为铀同位素分离专门设计或制造的激光器或激光系统。在以激光为基础的浓缩过程中有重要意义的激光器和激光部件包括《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》中所列的那些激光器和激光部件。激光系统一般包含用于管理激光束（一个或多个）和向同位素分离室发射激光束的光学和电子部件。AVLIS 过程使用的激光系统通常由两个激光器组成：一个铜蒸气激光器或某些固体激光器和一个可调染料激光器。MLIS 使用的激光系统通常由一个 CO2 激光器或受激准分子激光器和一个多程光室（两端有旋转镜）组成。这两种过程使用的激光器或激光系统都需要有一个谱频稳定器以便能够长时间地工作。
text.en: Lasers or laser systems specially designed or manufactured for uranium isotope separation. Lasers and laser components important to laser-based enrichment processes include those listed in the Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China. Laser systems generally incorporate optical and electronic components for managing one or more laser beams and directing them into the isotope separation chamber. Laser systems used in the AVLIS process generally consist of two lasers: a copper-vapor laser or certain solid-state lasers, and a tunable dye laser. Laser systems used in MLIS generally consist of a CO₂ laser or excimer laser and a multipass optical cell with rotating mirrors at both ends. Lasers or laser systems used in both processes require a spectrum-frequency stabilizer for extended operation.

text.zh: 同位素电磁分离器及部件
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators and components

text.zh:
为分离铀同位素专门设计或制造的同位素电磁分离器及其设备和部件包括：（a）离子源专门设计或制造的单个或多个铀离子源由蒸气源、电离器和束流加速器组成，用石墨、不锈钢或铜等适当材料制造，能提供总强度为 50mA 或更高的离子束流；（b）离子收集器收集器板极由专门为收集浓缩和贫化铀离子束而设计或制造的两个或多个槽和容器组成，用石墨或不锈钢一类的适当材料制造；（c）真空外壳为铀电磁分离器专门设计或制造的真空外壳，用不锈钢一类适当的非磁性材料制造，设计在 0.1Pa 或以下的压力下运行；
注释：外壳专门设计成装有离子源、收集器板极和水冷却管路，并有用于扩散泵连接结构和可用来移出和重新安装这些部件的开闭结构。（d）磁极块专门设计或制造的磁极块，直径大于2m，用来在同位素电磁分离器内维持恒定磁场并在毗连分离器之间传输磁场。
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators and their equipment and components specially designed or manufactured for separating uranium isotopes, including: (a) Ion sources: Specially designed or manufactured single or multiple uranium ion sources comprising a vapor source, ionizer and beam accelerator, made of suitable materials such as graphite, stainless steel or copper, and capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 mA or greater; (b) Ion collectors: collector plates comprising two or more slots and containers specially designed or prepared to collect enriched and depleted uranium ion beams, made of suitable materials such as graphite or stainless steel; (c) Vacuum housings: vacuum housings specially designed or prepared for electromagnetic uranium separators, made of suitable nonmagnetic materials such as stainless steel and designed to operate at pressures of 0.1 Pa or below; Explanatory Note: The housings are specially designed to contain ion sources, collector plates and water-cooling lines, and have diffusion-pump connections and opening and closing provisions for removing and reinstalling these components. (d) Magnet pole pieces: specially designed or prepared magnet pole pieces more than 2 m in diameter, used to maintain a constant magnetic field within electromagnetic isotope separators and transfer the magnetic field between adjacent separators.

text.zh: 注释：从铀矿石浓缩物到UO₃ 的转化可通过以下步骤实现：首先，用硝酸溶解铀矿石浓缩物，用磷酸三丁酯之类溶剂萃取纯化的硝酸铀酰；然后，硝酸铀酰通过浓缩和脱硝转化为UO₃，或用气态氨中和产生重铀酸铵，接着通过过滤、干燥和煅烧转化为UO₃。
text.en: Explanatory Note: Conversion of uranium ore concentrates to UO₃ may involve the following steps: first, dissolving the uranium ore concentrates in nitric acid and extracting purified uranyl nitrate with a solvent such as tributyl phosphate; then converting the uranyl nitrate to UO₃ by concentration and denitration, or neutralizing it with gaseous ammonia to produce ammonium diuranate, followed by filtration, drying and calcination to UO₃.

text.zh: 从UF₆ 到UO₂ 的转化，可用三种方法来实现。在第一种方法中，用氢气和水蒸气将UF₆ 还原并水解为UO₂。在第二种方法中，通过溶解在水中而将UF₆ 水解，然后加入氨沉淀出重铀酸铵，接着可在820℃用氢气将重铀酸铵还原为UO₂。在第三种方法中，将气态UF₆、CO₂ 和NH3 通入水中，结果沉淀出碳酸铀酰铵。在500-600℃，碳酸铀酰铵与水蒸气和氢气发生反应，生成UO₂。从UF₆ 到UO₂ 的转化，通常是燃料制造厂的第一个工序。
text.en: Conversion of UF₆ to UO₂ can be accomplished by three methods. In the first method, UF₆ is reduced and hydrolyzed to UO₂ using hydrogen and steam. In the second method, UF₆ is hydrolyzed by dissolution in water, ammonia is then added to precipitate ammonium diuranate, and the ammonium diuranate can subsequently be reduced to UO₂ with hydrogen at 820 °C. In the third method, gaseous UF₆, CO₂, and NH₃ are passed into water, precipitating ammonium uranyl carbonate. At 500–600 °C, ammonium uranyl carbonate reacts with steam and hydrogen to produce UO₂. Conversion from UF₆ to UO₂ is generally the first operation in a fuel-fabrication plant.

In the second process, UO₂ reacts with chlorine at approximately 700 °C in the presence of carbon black (CAS 1333-86-4) and carbon monoxide to produce UCl₄.

text.zh: 该流程包括的主要功能为：流程供料贮存和调料、沉淀和固-液分离，煅烧、产品处理、通风、废物管理，以及流程控制。流程系统经过特别的设计，以避免发生临界和辐射效应，以及使得毒性危险最小。在大多数后处理设施中，这一流程包括将硝酸钚转化到氧化钚。其它流程可能包括草酸钚或过氧化钚的沉淀。
text.en: The main functions of this process are process-feed storage and adjustment, precipitation and solid-liquid separation, calcination, product handling, ventilation, waste management and process control. The process systems are specially designed to avoid criticality and radiation effects and to minimize toxic hazards. In most reprocessing facilities, this process involves conversion of plutonium nitrate to plutonium oxide. Other processes may involve precipitation of plutonium oxalate or plutonium peroxide.

text.zh: 该流程通常包括氧化钚的氟化，通常以高腐蚀性的氢氟酸来生产氟化钚，而后用高纯钙金属还原生成金属钚和氟化钙残渣。该流程所包括的主要功能是氟化（例如，包括采用贵重金属制造的或作为内衬的设备）、金属还原（例如，使用陶瓷坩埚）、残渣回收、产品处理、通风、废物管理和流程控制。流程系统经过特别的设计，以避免发生临界和辐射效应，以及使得毒性危险最小。其它流程包括草酸钚或过氧化钚的氟化，然后还原成金属。
text.en: The process normally involves fluorination of plutonium oxide, usually with highly corrosive hydrofluoric acid, to produce plutonium fluoride, followed by reduction with high-purity calcium metal to produce plutonium metal and a calcium fluoride residue. The main functions of the process are fluorination, for example using equipment made of or lined with precious metals; metal reduction, for example using ceramic crucibles; residue recovery; product handling; ventilation; waste management; and process control. The process systems are specially designed to avoid criticality and radiation effects and to minimize toxic hazards. Other processes involve fluorination of plutonium oxalate or plutonium peroxide, followed by reduction to metal.

text.zh: 第一部分2020 年12 月1 日，《中华人民共和国出口管制法》正式施行，明确了出口管制领域实行清单管理制度；2024 年12 月1 日，《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》正式施行，对两用物项出口管制清单的制定、调整程序和要求作出具体规定。为确保《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》顺利、有效实施，便利出口经营者合规经营，提高出口管制治理效能，商务部会同有关部门借鉴国际经验和做法，系统整合了原《中华人民共和国核两用品及相关技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国导弹及相关物项和技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国生物两用品及相关设备和技术出口管制条例》《有关化学品及相关设备和技术出口管制办法》和现行《中华人民共和国监控化学品管理条例》等法规、规章所附出口管制清单，以及商务部会同有关部门发布的10 余个两用物项出口管制公告，形成了统一的《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》（以下简称清单），
text.en: Part One. The Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China took effect on December 1, 2020, establishing a list-based export control system; the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items took effect on December 1, 2024, specifying the procedures and requirements for establishing and adjusting the dual-use export control list. To ensure the effective implementation of the Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items, facilitate exporter compliance, and improve the effectiveness of export control administration, the Ministry of Commerce and relevant departments drew on international experience and practices to systematically integrate the export control lists annexed to the former Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Nuclear Dual-Use Items and Related Technologies, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Missiles and Related Items and Technologies, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Biological Dual-Use Items and Related Equipment and Technologies, Measures for Export Control of Related Chemicals and Related Equipment and Technologies, and the current Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on the Administration of Scheduled Chemicals, together with more than ten dual-use export control announcements issued by the Ministry of Commerce and relevant departments, into the unified Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People’s Republic of China (the “List”),

text.zh: 与《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》配套实施，作为出口经营者申请相关物项出口许可，以及商务部等部门实施行政许可和监督执法的重要依据。
text.en: which is implemented alongside the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items and serves as an important basis for exporters’ license applications and for administrative licensing, oversight, and enforcement by the Ministry of Commerce and other departments.

text.zh: 一、清单结构和编码规则本清单包含两部分：第一部分为清单说明，主要阐述清单的制定背景、依据和目的，明确物项编码规则，厘清必要技术说明和管制要求；第二部分为具体物项，将现行已列管的所有两用物项系统整合为10 大类行业领域，每一大类再细分为5 种物项类型，采用“阿拉伯数字+英文字母”的编码方式进行编排，由“1 个阿拉伯数字+1 个大写英文字母+3个阿拉伯数字”共5 个要素组合而成，如1C351、3A201 等。管制编码的具体含义如下：第1 位代表行业领域，用阿拉伯数字0-9 表示：1 代表“专用材料和相关设备、化学制品、微生物和毒素”；2 代表“材料加工”；3 代表“电子”；4 代表“计算机”；5 代表“电信和信息安全”；6 代表“传感器和激光器”；7 代表“导航和航空电子”；8 代表“船舶”；9 代表“航空航天与推进”；0 代表“其他物项”。第2 位代表物项类型，用大写英文字母A-E 表示：A 代表“系统、设备和部件”；B
text.en: I. List structure and coding rules. The List consists of two parts. Part One contains explanatory notes, primarily describing the background, legal basis, and objectives, specifying item-coding rules, and clarifying necessary technical notes and control requirements; Part Two sets out specific items, systematically consolidating all currently listed dual-use items into ten industry categories, each divided into five item types. Entries use an alphanumeric code comprising five characters: one digit, one uppercase English letter, and three digits, such as 1C351 or 3A201. The control codes mean the following. The first character denotes the industry category, using digits 0–9: 1 denotes “Special Materials and Related Equipment, Chemicals, Microorganisms, and Toxins”; 2 denotes “Materials Processing”; 3 denotes “Electronics”; 4 denotes “Computers”; 5 denotes “Telecommunications and Information Security”; 6 denotes “Sensors and Lasers”; 7 denotes “Navigation and Avionics”; 8 denotes “Marine”; 9 denotes “Aerospace and Propulsion”; 0 denotes “Other Items.” The second character denotes the item type, using uppercase letters A–E: A denotes “Systems, Equipment, and Components”; B

text.zh: 代表“测试、检测和生产设备”；C 代表“材料”；D 代表“软件”；E 代表“技术”。第3 位代表管控原因，用阿拉伯数字0-9 表示：0 代表“与常规武器相关”；1 代表“与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关”；2 代表“与核不扩散相关”；3 代表“与化学和生物武器相关”；4 代表“监控化学品”；5 代表“临时管制”；9 代表“与其他国家安全因素相关”。当某个管制物项涉及多个管控原因时，除临时管制外，其他情形以最主要的管控原因为准进行编排。第4 位和第5 位共同用于物项排序，用阿拉伯数字0-9表示。具体如下图所示：每个编码对应一个或多个管制物项，涉及多个管制物项或者多个编码层级的，采用小写英文字母和阿拉伯数字轮替使用的方式编制相应层级的编码，如在编码1C111 项下进一步编制1C111.a.1、1C111.b.1.a 等。
text.en: denotes “Test, Inspection, and Production Equipment”; C denotes “Materials”; D denotes “Software”; E denotes “Technology.” The third character denotes the reason for control, using digits 0–9: 0 denotes “Related to Conventional Arms”; 1 denotes “Related to Delivery Systems for Weapons of Mass Destruction”; 2 denotes “Related to Nuclear Nonproliferation”; 3 denotes “Related to Chemical and Biological Weapons”; 4 denotes “Scheduled Chemicals”; 5 denotes “Temporary Controls”; 9 denotes “Related to Other National Security Factors.” Where an item involves multiple reasons for control, it is organized according to the principal reason, except in the case of temporary controls. The fourth and fifth characters together sequence the items, using digits 0–9. As illustrated in the figure below, each code corresponds to one or more controlled items. Where multiple controlled items or coding levels are involved, lowercase English letters and digits alternate at successive levels, for example 1C111.a.1 and 1C111.b.1.a under 1C111.

text.zh:
（一）通用说明。
1．本清单中物项包括未使用的物项、使用过的物项，以及集成在其他产品中作为其主要成分且可被拆卸、移作他用的物项。本清单第二部分中另有规定的，依照其规定。
2．如果对本清单中物项的描述不含技术规格或限制条件，则该物项包含其全部品种。
3．本清单中与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关的物项（即管制编码第3 位为数字1 的物项）是指与能把500 kg 以上有效载荷投掷到300 km 以上的完整弹道导弹、运载火箭、探空火箭、巡航导弹和“无人驾驶航空器”，以及为其专门设计的生产设施相关的物项。
text.en: (I) General notes. 1. Items in this List include unused items, used items, and items incorporated as major components of other products that can be removed and repurposed. Where Part Two of this List provides otherwise, those provisions apply. 2. If an item description in this List contains no technical specifications or restrictions, the item includes all varieties. 3. Items related to delivery systems for weapons of mass destruction in this List, whose third code character is 1, refer to items associated with complete ballistic missiles, space-launch vehicles, sounding rockets, cruise missiles, and “unmanned aerial vehicles” capable of delivering payloads of 500 kg or more to ranges of 300 km or more, and production facilities specially designed therefor.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（二）关于“技术”的说明。
1．“技术”是指在产品的研发、生产或使用过程中所需的专门信息和知识，包括通过技术资料或技术支持转移或提供的技术。对技术的出口管制不适用于公共领域信息、基础科学研究中的技术或普通专利申请所必需的知识。
2．技术资料包括：蓝图、平面图、图表、模型、公式、工程设计和技术规格、手册与规程，及其被写入或记录在诸如磁盘、磁带、只读存储器等器件或其他载体上。
3．技术支持包括：技术指导、派遣熟练工人、培训、传授知识和技能、咨询服务。
4．本清单所列任一物项的出口许可亦包含对同一最终用户出口该物项的安装、运行、维护和修理所需最低限度的技术的许可。
text.en: (II) Notes on “technology.” 1. “Technology” means the specific information and knowledge needed for the development, production, or use of a product, including technology transferred or provided through technical data or technical assistance. Export controls on technology do not apply to information in the public domain, technology in basic scientific research, or knowledge necessary for ordinary patent applications. 2. Technical data include blueprints, plans, diagrams, models, formulas, engineering designs and specifications, manuals, and procedures, including when written or recorded on devices or other media such as disks, tapes, or read-only memories. 3. Technical assistance includes technical instruction, dispatch of skilled workers, training, transfer of knowledge and skills, and consulting services. 4. An export license for any item in this List also authorizes export to the same end user of the minimum technology necessary for that item’s installation, operation, maintenance, and repair.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（三）关于“软件”的说明。“软件”是指载入于有形媒体里的一个或多个“程序”或“微程序”的集合体。对“软件”转让的管制不适用于以下“软件”：
1．通常用以下方式提供给公众的“软件”：
（1）在没有限制的零售点中销售；
（2）专用于用户自身安装而无需供应商进一步具体支持的；
2．公共领域的。
text.en: (III) Notes on “software.” “Software” means a collection of one or more “programs” or “microprograms” stored on a tangible medium. Controls on “software” transfers do not apply to the following “software”: 1. “Software” generally available to the public as follows: (1) Sold at retail outlets without restrictions; (2) Designed for installation by the user without further substantial support from the supplier; 2. In the public domain.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （四）关于“公共领域”的说明。“公共领域”是指已经公开使用的技术或软件，而对其进一步扩大使用可以不加限制（受版权限制的上述技术或软件被包括在“公共领域”的范围以内）。
text.en: (IV) Notes on the “public domain.” “Public domain” means technology or software that has been made publicly available without restrictions on further dissemination; copyright restrictions do not exclude such technology or software from the “public domain.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （五）关于“基础科学研究”的说明。

summary.zh: （五）关于“基础科学研究”的说明。

text.zh: （五）关于“基础科学研究”的说明。“基础科学研究”是指为了获得有关现象或可观测事实的基本原理方面的新知识，基本上不具有特定实用目的或目标的实验性或理论性工作。
text.en: (V) Notes on “basic scientific research.” “Basic scientific research” means experimental or theoretical work undertaken principally to acquire new knowledge of the fundamental principles underlying phenomena or observable facts, without a specific practical aim or objective.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。

summary.zh: （六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。

text.zh:
（六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。
1．“研发”是指“生产”前的各个阶段：设计、设计研究、设计分析、设计概念、原型的装配和试验、小规模试生产计划、设计数据、把设计数据转换成产品的过程、外形设计、总体设计、布置。
2．“生产”是指所有的生产阶段：建造、工艺设计、加工制造、装配（安装）、总成、检验、试验、质量保证。
3．“使用”是指操作、安装（包括现场安装）、维护（检查）、维修、检修等活动。
text.en: (VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.” 1. “Development” means all stages before “production”: design, design research, design analysis, design concepts, prototype assembly and testing, pilot-production schemes, design data, conversion of design data into a product, configuration design, overall design, and layout. 2. “Production” means all production stages: construction, production engineering, manufacturing, assembly (installation), integration, inspection, testing, and quality assurance. 3. “Use” means activities such as operation, installation (including on-site installation), maintenance (inspection), repair, and overhaul.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （七）关于“可用于”“能够”的说明。“可用于”“能够”是指系统、设备、部件、组件或软件适合于某一特定用途，而不需要为这种特定用途对这些系统、设备、部件、组件或软件进行配置、改进或调整。
text.en: (VII) Notes on “usable in” and “capable of.” “Usable in” and “capable of” mean that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, or software are suitable for a particular purpose without configuration, modification, or adjustment for that purpose.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （八）关于“专门设计”的说明。“专门设计”是指针对某种特定目的而研发、且有独特性能的系统、设备、部件、组件、材料或软件。例如：一件为用于导弹而设计的设备，如果没有其他的功能或用途，那么就将其视为“专门设计”的设备。再如：一台为制造某种部件而设计的制造设备，如果不能生产其他部件，那么应当将其视为“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: (VIII) Notes on “specially designed.” “Specially designed” means systems, equipment, components, assemblies, materials, or software developed for a particular purpose and having unique properties. For example, equipment designed for use in missiles and having no other function or application is considered “specially designed.” Similarly, manufacturing equipment designed to produce a particular component and incapable of producing other components is considered “specially designed.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。“设计或改进”是指系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术作为研发和改进的对象，使其具有适用于某种特定应用的属性。“设计或改进”的系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术可用于其他应用。例如：为导弹设计的钛泵可以使用推进剂之外的腐蚀性液体。
text.en: (IX) Notes on “designed or modified.” “Designed or modified” means that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology have been developed or modified to possess properties suitable for a particular application. “Designed or modified” systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology may be used in other applications. For example, a titanium pump designed for a missile may handle corrosive liquids other than propellants.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （一）“按重量计”（第1、2 类）是指合金中某种元素的质量除以合金总质量再乘以100%，表示该元素的含量。
text.en: (I) “By weight” (Categories 1 and 2) means the mass of an element divided by the total mass of an alloy, multiplied by 100%, expressing the element’s content.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二）“比模量”（第1、9 类）是指在温度为23±2 ℃和相对湿度为50±5%的条件下测量的杨氏模量（单位：N/m²）除以比重（单位：N/m³）。
text.en: (II) “Specific modulus” (Categories 1 and 9) means Young’s modulus, in N/m², divided by specific weight, in N/m³, measured at a temperature of 23±2 °C and relative humidity of 50±5%.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三）“比抗拉强度”（第1、9 类）是指在温度为23±2 ℃和相对湿度为50±5%的条件下测量的极限抗拉强度（单位：N/m²）除以比重（单位：N/m³）。
text.en: (III) “Specific tensile strength” (Categories 1 and 9) means ultimate tensile strength, in N/m², divided by specific weight, in N/m³, measured at a temperature of 23±2 °C and relative humidity of 50±5%.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （四）“病原微生物”（第1 类）是指可使人、动物或植物致死、致病或/和受到损害的，天然的或经过遗传修饰的病原微生物。病原微生物包括细菌、病毒、真菌等。“细菌”是一种单细胞微生物。除少数例外情况，细菌属于不依赖于其他生物体即可完成自我复制的独立活体微生物。“病毒”是一种通常由包裹在蛋白质衣壳内的遗传物质组成的病原微生物。病毒必须感染宿主细胞才能复制、在宿主细胞内发生裂解并传播感染。“真菌”是以有机物为营养来源的一组单细胞和多细胞生物（如霉菌、酵母和蘑菇）。
text.en: (IV) “Pathogenic microorganisms” (Category 1) means naturally occurring or genetically modified pathogenic microorganisms that can cause death, disease, and/or harm in humans, animals, or plants. Pathogenic microorganisms include bacteria, viruses, fungi, etc. “Bacteria” are single-celled microorganisms. With few exceptions, bacteria are independent living microorganisms capable of reproducing without relying on other organisms. “Viruses” are pathogenic microorganisms generally consisting of genetic material enclosed in a protein capsid. Viruses must infect host cells to replicate, undergo lysis in host cells, and spread infection. “Fungi” are a group of unicellular and multicellular organisms, such as molds, yeasts, and mushrooms, that obtain nutrition from organic matter.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （五）“测量不确定度”（第2 类）是指规定可测变量的正确值以95%的置信水平处于输出值附近多大范围内的特性参数。这种特性参数包括未修正的系统偏差、未修正的游隙和随机偏差。
text.en: (V) “Measurement uncertainty” (Category 2) means the characteristic parameter defining the range around an output value within which the true value of the measurand lies at a 95% confidence level. This parameter includes uncorrected systematic bias, uncorrected backlash, and random deviations.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （六）“衬底”（第3 类）是指具有或不具有互连模式的基材，其上或其内可放置“分立器件”或集成电路或两者。
text.en: (VI) “Substrate” (Category 3) means a base material, with or without an interconnection pattern, on or within which “discrete devices,” integrated circuits, or both may be placed.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （七）“程序”（第1、2 类）是指电子计算机可执行的或可转换成可执行某一过程的指令序列。
text.en: (VII) “Program” (Categories 1 and 2) means a sequence of instructions executable by an electronic computer, or convertible into a form executable by it, to perform a process.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （八）“成形控制”（第2 类）是指根据指令进行两种或多种“数控”动作，该指令规定了下一个所要求的位置和到达该位置所要求的进刀速度。而进刀速度随彼此间的关系变化，以便得到一种所要求的成形（参见ISO2806:1994）。
text.en: (VIII) “Contouring control” (Category 2) means two or more “numerically controlled” motions performed according to instructions specifying the next required position and the feed rate required to reach it. The feed rates vary in relation to each other to produce the desired contour (see ISO2806:1994).

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （九）“等静压压力机”（第2 类）是指能够通过各种介质（气体、液体、固体颗粒等）对封闭型腔加压，从而在型腔内各个方向对工件或材料产生相等压力的设备。
text.en: (IX) “Isostatic presses” (Category 2) means equipment capable of pressurizing a closed cavity through various media, such as gases, liquids, or solid particles, to exert equal pressure in all directions on a workpiece or material within the cavity.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十）“电子组件”（第4 类）是指连接在一起以执行特定功能的多个电子元件（即“电路元件”“分立器件”、集成电路等），可以整体更换，通常可拆卸。
text.en: (X) “Electronic assemblies” (Category 4) means multiple electronic components, such as “circuit elements,” “discrete devices,” or integrated circuits, connected together to perform a specific function, replaceable as a unit, and normally disassemblable.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（十一）“定位精度”（第2 类），根据第2B201 项，连同以下要求提出和确定“数控”机床的“定位精度”：
1．检验条件（ISO230-2:1988 第3 节或等效国家标准）：
（1）在测量前12 小时和测量期间，机床和精度测量设备要保持在相同的环境温度下。在预测期间，机床的滑座要连续地作与在精度测量期间所作循环同样的循环；
（2）机床将配备随机床一并出口的机械的、电子的或软件的附件；
（3）用于测量的测量设备的精度应至少优于预期机床精度的4 倍；
（4）用于驱动滑座的电源必须是：①线电压变化不得大于标称额定电压的±10%；②频率变化不超出正常频率的±2 Hz；③不允许线路停电或断续供电。
2．检验程序（ISO230-2:1988 第4 节或等效国家标准）：
（1）测量时进给率（滑座速度）必须是快速横向移动的速率；
技术说明：对于产生光学品质表面的机床，进给率必须小于等于每分钟50 mm；
（2）必须以增量方式进行测量，
text.en: (XI) “Positioning accuracy” (Category 2): Under 2B201, the “positioning accuracy” of “numerically controlled” machine tools must be stated and determined subject to the following requirements: 1. Test conditions (ISO230-2:1988, Section 3, or an equivalent national standard): (1) The machine tool and accuracy-measuring equipment must be maintained at the same ambient temperature for 12 hours before and throughout measurement. During the premeasurement period, the machine’s slides must cycle continuously through the same cycles used during accuracy measurement; (2) The machine tool must be equipped with the mechanical, electronic, or software accessories exported with it; (3) The measuring equipment must have an accuracy at least four times better than the machine tool’s expected accuracy; (4) The power supply driving the slides must meet the following: ① line-voltage variation must not exceed ±10% of nominal rated voltage; ② frequency variation must remain within ±2 Hz of normal frequency; ③ power outages or interruptions are not permitted. 2. Test procedure (ISO230-2:1988, Section 4, or an equivalent national standard): (1) The feed rate (slide velocity) during measurement must be the rapid-traverse rate; Technical Note: For machine tools producing optical-quality surfaces, the feed rate must be 50 mm per minute or less; (2) Measurements must be made incrementally,

text.zh:
即从轴向行程的一个端点至另一个端点而不返回到起始位置，每次移动都朝向目标位置；
（3）在检验某一轴线时，其它的轴线必须保持在行程中间位置。
3．检验结果的说明（ISO230-2:1988 第2 节或等效国家标准）：测量结果必须包括：
（1）“定位精度”；
（2）正反向平均误差。
text.en: from one end of the axis travel to the other without returning to the starting position, each movement being toward the target position; (3) When testing one axis, all other axes must remain at mid-travel. 3. Presentation of test results (ISO230-2:1988, Section 2, or an equivalent national standard): Results must include: (1) “Positioning accuracy”; (2) Mean reversal error.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十二）“毒素”（第1、2 类）是指源于任何微生物、动物、植物，可使人、动物或植物致死、致病或/和受到损害的，而无论以何种方式产生的天然的或经过修饰的生物活性物质。
text.en: (XII) “Toxins” (Categories 1 and 2) means naturally occurring or modified biologically active substances derived from any microorganism, animal, or plant, however produced, that can cause death, disease, and/or harm in humans, animals, or plants.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十三）“对称密码算法”（第5 类）是指加密和解密变换使用相同密钥的密码算法。
text.en: (XIII) “Symmetric cryptographic algorithm” (Category 5) means a cryptographic algorithm using the same key for encryption and decryption transformations.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十四）“非对称密码算法”（第5 类）是指加密和解密变换使用不同密钥的密码算法，其中一个密钥称为公钥，另外一个密钥称为私钥。
text.en: (XIV) “Asymmetric cryptographic algorithm” (Category 5) means a cryptographic algorithm using different keys for encryption and decryption transformations, one called the public key and the other the private key.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十五）“分辨率”（第2、3 类）是指测量装置可分辨的最小增量；在数字测量仪上为最低有效位。
text.en: (XV) “Resolution” (Categories 2 and 3) means the smallest increment a measuring device can distinguish; for a digital measuring instrument, it is the least significant bit.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十六）“高空”（第9 类）是指航空领域高度在7000~15000 米空域。
text.en: (XVI) “High altitude” (Category 9) means airspace at altitudes of 7000–15000 meters in aviation.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十七）“高温合金”（第9 类）是指含难熔金属的镍基合金、钴基合金或铁基合金，可在600 ℃及以上的氧化和热腐蚀条件下承受复杂应力，仍具有良好的综合性能，并能长期可靠工作的金属材料，又被称为“超合金”。
text.en: (XVII) “Superalloys” (Category 9) means nickel-, cobalt-, or iron-based alloys containing refractory metals that withstand complex stresses under oxidizing and hot-corrosion conditions at 600 °C or above while retaining good overall properties and reliable long-term operation; also called “high-temperature alloys.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（十八）“化学武器”（第1 类）是单指或合指：
1．有毒化学品及其前体，但预定用于《禁止化学武器公约》不加禁止的目的者除外，只要种类和数量符合此种目的；
2．经专门设计通过使用后而释放出的本款1 项所指有毒化学品的毒性造成死亡或其他伤害的弹花和装置；
3．经专门设计其用途与本款2 项所指弹花和装置的使用直接有关的任何设备。
text.en: (XVIII) “Chemical weapons” (Category 1) means the following, together or separately: 1. Toxic chemicals and their precursors, except where intended for purposes not prohibited by the Chemical Weapons Convention, provided that the types and quantities are consistent with those purposes; 2. Munition “flowers” [source wording; likely munitions] and devices specially designed to cause death or other harm through the toxic properties of the toxic chemicals in paragraph 1 released as a result of their use; 3. Any equipment specially designed for use directly in connection with the use of the munition “flowers” [source wording; likely munitions] and devices in paragraph 2.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （十九）“化学武器前体”（第1 类）是指在生产有毒化学品的任何阶段，参与此生产过程的任何化学反应物，其中包括二元或多元化学系统的任何关键组分。
text.en: (XIX) “Chemical weapon precursors” (Category 1) means any chemical reactant participating at any stage in the production of a toxic chemical, including any key component of a binary or multicomponent chemical system.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十）“激光”（第2、3、6、7、9 类）是一种通过受激辐射的放大而产生空间和时间相干光的物项。
text.en: (XX) “Laser” (Categories 2, 3, 6, 7, and 9) means an item producing spatially and temporally coherent light through amplification by stimulated emission of radiation.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（二十一）“加密”（第3、5、6 类）是指体现数据转换的原则、手段和方法以隐藏其信息内容、防止其未被发现的修改或防止其未经授权使用的学科。“加密”仅限于使用一个或多个“秘密参数”（例如：加密变量）或相关密钥管理的信息转换。
说明：
1．“加密”不包括“固定”数据压缩或编码技术；
2．“加密”包括解密。
技术说明：
1．“加密参数”：不为他人所知或仅在组内共享的常数或密钥；
2．“固定”：编码或压缩算法不能接受外部提供的参数（例如：密码或密钥变量）并且不能由用户修改。
text.en: (XXI) “Cryptography” (Categories 3, 5, and 6) means the discipline embodying the principles, means, and methods of transforming data to conceal its information content, prevent undetected modification, or prevent unauthorized use. “Cryptography” is limited to transformations using one or more “secret parameters,” such as cryptographic variables, or associated key management. Notes: 1. “Cryptography” does not include “fixed” data-compression or coding techniques; 2. “Cryptography” includes decryption. Technical Notes: 1. “Cryptographic parameter”: a constant or key unknown to others or shared only within a group; 2. “Fixed”: a coding or compression algorithm that cannot accept externally supplied parameters, such as cryptographic or key variables, and cannot be modified by the user.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十二）“角位偏差”（第2 类）是指在工作台上的工件已移出其初始位置后，精确测量的实际角位与理论角位之间的最大差值。
text.en: (XXII) “Angular position deviation” (Category 2) means the maximum difference between precisely measured actual angular position and theoretical angular position after a workpiece on a table moves from its initial position.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十三）“介电常数”（第1 类）是反映压电材料电介质在静电场作用下介电性质或极化性质的主要参数。
text.en: (XXIII) “Dielectric constant” (Category 1) is a principal parameter describing the dielectric or polarization properties of a piezoelectric material’s dielectric under an electrostatic field.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十四）“精度”（第2、3、7 类）通常以误差来衡量精度，即某一指示值同标准值或真值之间的最大正负偏差。
text.en: (XXIV) “Accuracy” (Categories 2, 3, and 7) is generally measured by error, meaning the maximum positive or negative deviation of an indicated value from a reference or true value.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十五）“绝压”（第9 类）即绝对压力，是指介质所处空间的所有压力。
text.en: (XXV) “Absolute pressure” (Category 9) means the total pressure in the space occupied by a medium.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十六）“抗辐射加固”（第4、6、9 类）是指设计用于抵抗辐射的某种组件或设备，其抗辐射水平达到甚至可以超过5×10⁵ 拉德（Si）的辐射总剂量。
text.en: (XXVI) “Radiation hardening” (Categories 4, 6, and 9) means components or equipment designed to resist radiation at total doses of 5×10⁵ rad (Si) or even higher.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十七）“拉伸断裂应变”（第1 类）是指材料在受到拉伸力作用下发生的形变。
text.en: (XXVII) “Tensile strain to failure” (Category 1) means the deformation of a material under tensile force.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十八）“漂移率”（第7 类）是指在外干扰力矩作用下陀螺仪自转轴在单位时间内相对惯性空间的偏差角，其单位是度/小时，是衡量陀螺仪“精度”的主要性能指标，漂移率越小，陀螺仪“精度”越高。
text.en: (XXVIII) “Drift rate” (Category 7) means the angular deviation per unit time of a gyroscope’s spin axis relative to inertial space under external disturbing torque. Expressed in degrees per hour, it is a principal measure of gyroscope “accuracy”: the lower the drift rate, the higher the “accuracy.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （二十九）“平均输出功率”（第6 类）是指总“激光”输出能量，以焦耳为单位，除以发射一系列连续脉冲的周期，单位为秒。对于一系列均匀间隔的脉冲，它等于单个脉冲中的总“激光”输出能量（以焦耳为单位）乘以“激光”的脉冲频率（以赫兹为单位）。
text.en: (XXIX) “Average output power” (Category 6) means total “laser” output energy in joules divided by the period in seconds over which a series of consecutive pulses is emitted. For equally spaced pulses, it equals the total “laser” output energy in a single pulse, in joules, multiplied by the “laser” pulse frequency, in hertz.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十）“腔室内径”（第2 类）是指同时达到工作温度和工作压力的腔室尺寸，但不包括夹具。该尺寸是压力室内径或绝缘炉室内径的较小者，具体取决于两室中哪个腔室在另个腔室内。
text.en: (XXX) “Inside chamber diameter” (Category 2) means the dimensions of the chamber in which both operating temperature and operating pressure are achieved, excluding fixtures. It is the smaller of the inside diameter of the pressure chamber and the insulated furnace chamber, depending on which chamber is inside the other.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十一）“热膨胀系数”（第1 类）是指物体由于温度改变而有胀缩现象。其变化能力以等压下，单位温度变化所导致的长度量值的变化表示。
text.en: (XXXI) “Coefficient of thermal expansion” (Category 1) refers to the expansion or contraction of an object caused by a temperature change. The extent of that change is expressed as the change in length per unit temperature change at constant pressure.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（三十二）“射/航程”（第9 类）是指定的火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统在稳定飞行模式下能够飞行的最大距离，由其轨迹在地球表面的投影来测量。
技术说明：
1．在确定射/航程时，考虑的是满载燃料或推进剂时基于系统设计特性的最大能力；
2．在确定火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统的射/航程时，应排除所有外部因素，如操作、遥测、数据链及其他外部约束和限制因素；
3．对于火箭系统，射程是在假定国际民航组织标准大气且无风情况下，以最大射程轨迹确定的飞行距离；
4．对于“无人驾驶航空器”，航程是在假定国际民航组织标准大气且无风情况下，以最高燃烧效率飞行状态或电池最高放电效率确定的单程距离。
text.en: (XXXII) “Range” (Category 9) means the maximum distance a specified rocket system or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system can travel in a stable flight mode, measured by the projection of its trajectory on the Earth’s surface. Technical Notes: 1. Range determination considers the maximum capability based on the system’s design characteristics when fully loaded with fuel or propellant; 2. In determining the range of a rocket or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system, exclude all external factors, such as operational, telemetry, data-link, and other external constraints or limitations; 3. For rocket systems, range is the flight distance determined using the maximum-range trajectory under an assumed ICAO standard atmosphere with zero wind; 4. For “unmanned aerial vehicles,” range is the one-way distance determined at the flight condition of highest fuel efficiency or highest battery-discharge efficiency under an assumed ICAO standard atmosphere with zero wind.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十三）“数控”（第1、2 类）是指通过一种装置来执行某一过程的自动控制，该装置通常在操作中引入数字数据（参见ISO2382:2015）。
text.en: (XXXIII) “Numerical control” (Categories 1 and 2) means automated control of a process by a device that normally introduces numerical data during operation (see ISO2382:2015).

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（三十四）“数字计算机”（第4 类）是指能够以一个或多个离散变量的形式执行以下所有操作的设备：
1．接收数据；
2．将数据或指令存储在固定或可更改（可写）的存储设备中；
3．通过存储的可修改指令序列处理数据；
4．提供数据输出。
技术说明：对存储的指令序列的修改包括更换固定存储设备，但不包括物理更改接线或互连。
text.en: (XXXIV) “Digital computer” (Category 4) means equipment capable of performing all of the following operations in the form of one or more discrete variables: 1. Receiving data; 2. Storing data or instructions in fixed or alterable (writable) storage devices; 3. Processing data through a stored sequence of modifiable instructions; 4. Providing data output. Technical Note: Modification of a stored instruction sequence includes replacement of fixed storage devices, but excludes physical alteration of wiring or interconnections.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十五）“微程序”（关于“软件”的说明）是指保持在一个特殊的存储器里的基本指令序列，通过把其参考指令引入指令寄存器开始执行该基本指令序列。
text.en: (XXXV) “Microprogram” (Notes on “Software”) means a sequence of elementary instructions held in a special memory, execution of which is initiated by loading its reference instruction into an instruction register.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十六）“无人驾驶飞艇”（第9 类）是指轻于空气的由动力驱动的“无人驾驶航空器”，主要靠空气净浮力升空。
text.en: (XXXVI) “Unmanned airship” (Category 9) means a powered, lighter-than-air “unmanned aerial vehicle” that rises primarily through net buoyancy in air.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十七）“无人驾驶航空器”（第9 类）是指由遥控设备或自备程序控制装置操控，机上无人驾驶的航空器。
text.en: (XXXVII) “Unmanned aerial vehicle” (Category 9) means an aircraft with no pilot on board, operated by remote-control equipment or an onboard programmed control device.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh:
（三十八）“纤维或纤丝材料”（第1 类）是指连续的单纤丝、细线、粗纱、纱或带。其中：
1．纤丝或单纤丝是指纤维的最小增量，直径通常为几微米。
2．粗纱是指一股大致平行的细纱束（典型情况为12~120根细纱）。
3．细纱是指大致平行排列的一股纤维束（典型情况为200 多根纤维）。
4．带是指一种由通常预先浸渍过树脂并交织在一起或单向排列的纤维、细纱、粗纱、纱或细线等构成的材料。
5．纱是指一股通常大致平行的纤维束。
6．细线是指一股绞在一起的细纱束。
text.en: (XXXVIII) “Fibrous or filamentary materials” (Category 1) means continuous monofilaments, tows, rovings, yarns, or tapes. For these purposes: 1. Filaments or monofilaments are the smallest fiber elements, generally a few micrometers in diameter. 2. Rovings are bundles of approximately parallel strands, typically 12–120 strands. 3. Strands are bundles of approximately parallel fibers, typically more than 200 fibers. 4. Tape is material composed of fibers, strands, rovings, yarns, tows, etc., generally preimpregnated with resin and interwoven or arranged unidirectionally. 5. Yarn is a bundle of fibers generally arranged approximately in parallel. 6. Tow is a bundle of twisted strands.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （三十九）“线性度”（第2、3 类）（通常以非线性度衡量）是实际特性值相对一直线的最大正负值偏差（高端和低端读数的平均值），正值或负值，该直线的位置应使最大偏差均衡设置并减至最小。
text.en: (XXXIX) “Linearity” (Categories 2 and 3), generally measured as nonlinearity, means the maximum positive or negative deviation of the actual characteristic from a straight line (the average of upper and lower readings), with the line positioned to equalize and minimize the maximum deviations.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （四十）“疫苗”（第1 类）是指经国家主管部门批准进行临床试验、生产或上市销售的，可激发人或动物产生保护性免疫反应，以预防由该种微生物或毒素所致疾病或中毒的生物制剂。
text.en: (XL) “Vaccines” (Category 1) means biological preparations approved by the competent national authority for clinical trials, production, or marketing, capable of inducing protective immune responses in humans or animals to prevent disease or poisoning caused by the microorganism or toxin concerned.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （四十一）“炸药”（第1、2、3 类）是指固体、液体或气体物质或物质混合物，在弹头、爆破和其他应用中作为首要装药、助推器或主要装药时，需要引爆。
text.en: (XLI) “Explosives” (Categories 1, 2, and 3) means solid, liquid, or gaseous substances or mixtures requiring detonation when used as primary charges, boosters, or main charges in warheads, demolition, or other applications.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

text.zh: （四十二）“载荷”（第9 类）是指航空器所能携带的有效负荷，包括任务设备、燃料、乘客等。有效载荷可由特定火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统携带或投送的总质量，不用于维持飞行。有效载荷是否包含特定设备、分系统或部件取决于相关飞行器的类型和配置。
text.en: (XLII) “Payload” (Category 9) means the useful load an aircraft can carry, including mission equipment, fuel, passengers, etc. Payload is the total mass that a particular rocket or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system can carry or deliver that is not used to maintain flight. Whether particular equipment, subsystems, or components are included in payload depends on the type and configuration of the vehicle concerned.

两用物项和技术进出口许可证管理目录
说明：一、本目录分为《两用物项和技术进口许可证管理目录》与《两用物项和技术出口许可证管理目录》。二、本目录所列物项和技术是指依据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》《中华人民共和国密码法》等相关法律、行政法规和规章实施管制或管理的物项和技术。三、进出口本目录的物项和技术，不论该物项和技术是否在本目录中列明海关商品编号，均应依法办理两用物项和技术进出口许可证。四、本目录所列物项和技术及其商品名称和描述与相关法律、行政法规、规章、《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》及相关公告不一致时，以相关法律、行政法规、规章、《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》及相关公告为准。
text.en: Catalog for the Administration of Import and Export Licenses for Dual-Use Items and Technologies Notes: I. This Catalog consists of the Catalog for the Administration of Import Licenses for Dual-Use Items and Technologies and the Catalog for the Administration of Export Licenses for Dual-Use Items and Technologies. II. The items and technologies listed in this Catalog are those subject to control or administration under relevant laws, administrative regulations, and rules, including the Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Cryptography Law of the People’s Republic of China. III. Imports or exports of items and technologies in this Catalog require the applicable dual-use items and technologies import or export license in accordance with law, whether or not a customs commodity code is listed in the Catalog. IV. Where the items, technologies, commodity names, or descriptions in this Catalog are inconsistent with relevant laws, administrative regulations, rules, the Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People’s Republic of China, or relevant announcements, those laws, administrative regulations, rules, the control list, and announcements prevail.

text.zh: 《清单》用于识别物项的管制范围、技术条件、例外及相关软件/技术；《目录》把许可证管理范围按进出口方向列示，并提供参考商品名称、海关商品编号、计量单位。二者是实体范围与办证/通关索引相互配合的关系。
text.en: The Control List identifies the scope, technical conditions, exclusions, and related software/technology subject to control; the Catalog presents licensing scope by import/export direction and provides reference commodity names, customs commodity codes, and units of measurement. The two complement one another: substantive control scope and a licensing/customs reference index.

text.zh: 《目录》出口第二大类是核出口管制清单所列物项和技术；《清单》编码第3位为2表示与核不扩散相关的管控原因。二者有联系但不是同一个清单，不应把目录核出口条目强配到两用5位编码。
text.en: The Catalog’s second major export category covers items and technologies on the nuclear export control list; a third character of 2 in a Control List code indicates a reason for control related to nuclear nonproliferation. These are related but are not the same list; nuclear export catalog entries must not be forced into five-character dual-use codes.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 易制毒目的地限制不能丢
title.en: Retain destination conditions for drug precursors

summary.zh: 易制毒目的地限制不能丢
summary.en: Retain destination conditions for drug precursors

text.zh: 目录出口易制毒分（一）、（二）、（三）。（二）13项及可能存在的盐类，对美国、墨西哥、加拿大等特定国家（地区）；（三）41项，对缅甸、老挝、阿富汗等特定国家（地区）。表中“等”不是封闭列举，执行时查相应公告完整目的地。
text.en: The Catalog divides drug-precursor exports into subsections (I), (II), and (III). Subsection (II) contains 13 items and any salts in which they may exist, for specified countries or regions including the United States, Mexico, and Canada; subsection (III) contains 41 items, for specified countries or regions including Myanmar, Laos, and Afghanistan. “Including” is not an exhaustive list; consult the relevant announcement for the complete destination scope.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

text.zh: 清单通则覆盖新旧物项，也覆盖集成在其他产品中作为主要成分且可拆卸、移作他用的物项；第二部分另有规定时按特别条款。不能因为是整机、旧货或返修件自动排除。
text.en: The Control List’s general rules cover both new and used items, as well as items incorporated as major components of other products that can be removed and repurposed; special provisions in Part Two apply where provided. Complete equipment, used goods, or goods returned for repair are not automatically excluded.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

text.zh: E类技术可包括设计图纸、工艺参数、手册、培训和咨询；通则规定公共领域、基础科学研究、普通专利申请必需知识的边界。货物结论不能直接代替技术结论，企业内部资料不能仅因已在公司内部分享而视为公共领域。
text.en: Category E technology may include design drawings, process parameters, manuals, training, and consulting; the general rules define the limits for the public domain, basic scientific research, and knowledge necessary for ordinary patent applications. A goods determination does not substitute for a technology determination; internal company materials do not enter the public domain merely because they have been shared within the company.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

text.zh: 必须保留“所有/两种/任一”、≥与>、≤与<、“且/或”、纯度、温度、尺寸、单位、用途及排除条款。“没有限制条件”按通则包含全部品种，而不是不管制。
text.en: Retain “all/both/any,” ≥ versus >, ≤ versus <, AND/OR relationships, purity, temperature, dimensions, units, uses, and exclusions. Under the general rules, “no restrictive conditions” means all varieties are included, not that the item is uncontrolled.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.en: No search result does not mean no control

summary.en: No search result does not mean no control

text.zh: 检索未命中只说明未在本工作簿定位到。仍应核对同义词、部件、材料、软件、技术、临时管制和最新公告，并审查最终用户、最终用途及出口管制法第12条的清单外风险。
text.en: No search result only means that the workbook has not located an entry. Still check synonyms, components, materials, software, technology, temporary controls, and current announcements, and review end users, end uses, and risks involving unlisted items under Article 12 of the Export Control Law.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 许可不等于当然可出口
title.en: A license requirement does not mean export is necessarily permitted

summary.zh: 许可不等于当然可出口
summary.en: A license requirement does not mean export is necessarily permitted

text.zh: 列管一般意味着需要依法申请相应许可，是否准予还取决于目的地、最终用户/用途及禁止性措施。部分交易可能禁止，不应将检索命中统一显示为“办证即可”。
text.en: Control generally requires application for the relevant license in accordance with law; approval also depends on destination, end user/end use, and prohibitions. Some transactions may be prohibited; a search match must not uniformly be presented as “obtain a license and export.”

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

text.zh: 工作簿主数据应忠实于两份附件；附件外的目的地、实体、最终用户/用途及暂停实施措施应独立标注，不悄悄改写附件。2025年第70号暂停范围及截止2026-11-10、2026年第1号和第34号可作时效示例；此示例不是截至2026-10-19的全部专项措施清单。
text.en: Workbook master data must remain faithful to the two attachments; destination, entity, end-user/end-use, and suspension measures outside the attachments must be separately identified, without silently rewriting the attachments. The suspension scope and November 10, 2026 end date in Announcement No. 70 of 2025, and Announcements No. 1 and No. 34 of 2026, may be used as examples of time-sensitive measures; these examples are not an exhaustive list of special measures as of October 19, 2026.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 不得复用已过期过渡期
title.en: Do not reuse an expired transition period

summary.zh: 不得复用已过期过渡期
summary.en: Do not reuse an expired transition period

text.zh: 目录末页关于调整HS的已领证过渡安排只允许在许可证有效期内使用至2026-03-31。这不是目录本身的有效期，也不是所有许可证通用有效期；截至本次整理2026-10-19该过渡期已过。
text.en: The final-page transition arrangement for issued licenses affected by HS-code changes permits use only within the license validity period and no later than March 31, 2026. This is neither the Catalog’s validity period nor a universal validity period for all licenses; as of the compilation date, October 19, 2026, the transition period has expired.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.en: Codes are not interchangeable with U.S. or EU codes

summary.en: Codes are not interchangeable with U.S. or EU codes

text.zh: 中国5位编码的格式可能与其他国家类似，但本表仅对应中国规则；不能把中国编码当成美国ECCN、欧盟附件I编码或海关HS。跨法域需分别识别。
text.en: China’s five-character codes may resemble other countries’ codes in format, but this table concerns Chinese rules only; do not treat Chinese codes as U.S. ECCNs, EU Annex I codes, or customs HS codes. Classify separately for each jurisdiction.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

text.zh: 先选进口或出口；有管制编码按编码查；只有HS按HS查线索；只有商品名称则用名称、材料、部件或技术关键词查。命中后必须看完整条件。
text.en: First select imports or exports; if you have a control code, search by code; if you only have an HS code, use it as a lead; if you only have a product name, search by name, material, component, or technology keywords. After finding a match, read the full conditions.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 5位管制编码和10位HS有什么区别？
title.en: What is the difference between a five-character control code and a ten-digit HS code?

summary.zh: 5位管制编码和10位HS有什么区别？
summary.en: What is the difference between a five-character control code and a ten-digit HS code?

text.zh: 5位管制编码标识中国出口管制清单条目；HS是通关商品归类信息。两者可能一对多或多对多，不能互换。
text.en: A five-character control code identifies an entry in China’s export control list; HS codes provide commodity classification information for customs purposes. The relationship may be one-to-many or many-to-many; the codes are not interchangeable.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: HS编号查到了，是否一定要许可证？
title.en: Does an HS-code match always mean a license is required?

summary.zh: HS编号查到了，是否一定要许可证？
summary.en: Does an HS-code match always mean a license is required?

text.zh: 不一定。先核对名称、技术指标、用途、说明和排除条件；HS只是参考线索。
text.en: Not necessarily. First check the name, technical parameters, use, notes, and exclusions; HS codes are reference leads only.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: HS空白或找不到，是否就无需许可证？
title.en: If the HS field is blank or no code is found, does that mean no license is required?

summary.zh: HS空白或找不到，是否就无需许可证？
summary.en: If the HS field is blank or no code is found, does that mean no license is required?

text.zh: 不能这样判断。目录明确不论是否列有HS都应依法办理；部分技术本来就没有HS。
text.en: No such conclusion can be drawn. The Catalog expressly requires the applicable license in accordance with law whether or not an HS code is listed; some technologies have no HS code.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 商品名字相同是否就列管？
title.en: Does an identical product name establish control?

summary.zh: 商品名字相同是否就列管？
summary.en: Does an identical product name establish control?

text.zh: 仍需核对完整技术条件。若条目本身没有技术规格或限制条件，按清单通则包含全部品种。
text.en: The full technical conditions still need to be checked. If the entry contains no technical specifications or restrictions, the Control List’s general rules include all varieties.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 搜索没有结果可以直接出口吗？
title.en: Can I export immediately if the search returns no results?

summary.zh: 搜索没有结果可以直接出口吗？
summary.en: Can I export immediately if the search returns no results?

text.zh: 不可以据此下结论。换用同义词、材料/部件/技术名称再查，同时复核最新措施、临时管制及清单外风险。
text.en: That conclusion cannot be based on the search result alone. Search again using synonyms and material/component/technology names, and review current measures, temporary controls, and risks involving unlisted items.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 为什么同一物项有多行？
title.en: Why does the same item appear in multiple rows?

summary.zh: 为什么同一物项有多行？
summary.en: Why does the same item appear in multiple rows?

text.zh: 目录可能按子项、参考商品名称或HS拆行；同一种化学品也可能同时涉及进口和出口或不同管制制度。重复名称不代表重复规则。
text.en: The Catalog may split rows by subitem, reference commodity name, or HS code; the same chemical may also be covered for both imports and exports or under different regulatory regimes. Repeated names do not mean duplicate rules.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 为什么有些行没有5位管制编码？
title.en: Why do some rows have no five-character control code?

summary.zh: 为什么有些行没有5位管制编码？
summary.en: Why do some rows have no five-character control code?

text.zh: 进口目录、核出口清单和易制毒栏目不都采用两用清单5位编码。应使用本栏原序号和所属制度定位，不能自行编造中国管制编码。
text.en: The import catalog, nuclear export control list, and drug-precursor sections do not all use the dual-use list’s five-character codes. Use the original entry number and applicable regime to locate the item; do not invent Chinese control codes.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: “所有特性”和“任一特性”有什么差别？
title.en: What is the difference between “all characteristics” and “any characteristic”?

summary.zh: “所有特性”和“任一特性”有什么差别？
summary.en: What is the difference between “all characteristics” and “any characteristic”?

text.zh: 前者通常要求所列条件同时满足，后者满足任一即可；还要把上级条文、用途、说明和排除条件一起读，不能孤立看某一个指标。
text.en: The former generally requires all listed conditions to be met together; the latter requires any one; also read the parent provision, use, notes, and exclusions rather than isolating a single parameter.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: “大于”和“大于等于”可以等同吗？
title.en: Can “greater than” and “greater than or equal to” be treated as the same?

summary.zh: “大于”和“大于等于”可以等同吗？
summary.en: Can “greater than” and “greater than or equal to” be treated as the same?

text.zh: 不可以。等号会决定临界值是否命中；单位换算、测试条件和精度也应核实。不得为了筛选方便删除符号。
text.en: No. The equality sign determines whether the boundary value is included; verify unit conversions, test conditions, and accuracy as well. Do not remove symbols merely to simplify filtering.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 只卖民用客户是否自动不受管制？
title.en: Does selling only to civilian customers automatically avoid control?

summary.zh: 只卖民用客户是否自动不受管制？
summary.en: Does selling only to civilian customers automatically avoid control?

text.zh: 不自动排除。清单列管物项有民用用途仍可能需要许可；最终用户与最终用途是独立审查维度。
text.en: No automatic exclusion applies. Listed controlled items may still require licenses for civilian uses; end users and end uses are separate review factors.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 旧设备、样品、赠品、返修是否自动豁免？
title.en: Are used equipment, samples, gifts, or repair returns automatically exempt?

summary.zh: 旧设备、样品、赠品、返修是否自动豁免？
summary.en: Are used equipment, samples, gifts, or repair returns automatically exempt?

text.zh: 旧设备已明确纳入通则；非贸易方式也可能构成出口。具体维修、展览等是否能适用便利措施须另查条件，不能一概豁免。
text.en: Used equipment is expressly included in the general rules; noncommercial transfers may also constitute exports. Whether facilitation measures apply to particular repairs, exhibitions, etc., requires a separate conditions check; there is no blanket exemption.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 零部件装进整机后就不管制了吗？
title.en: Do components cease to be controlled once installed in complete equipment?

summary.zh: 零部件装进整机后就不管制了吗？
summary.en: Do components cease to be controlled once installed in complete equipment?

text.zh: 不能一概排除。先核对通则关于主要成分、可拆卸移作他用的条件及该条目特别说明；也不能反过来认为含任何微量列管材料的所有整机必然列管。
text.en: There is no blanket exclusion. First check the general-rule conditions concerning major components, removability, and repurposing, together with entry-specific notes; conversely, do not assume that every complete product containing any trace amount of a listed material is necessarily controlled.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 图纸、源代码、培训资料要查吗？
title.en: Must drawings, source code, and training materials be checked?

summary.zh: 图纸、源代码、培训资料要查吗？
summary.en: Must drawings, source code, and training materials be checked?

text.zh: 需要按软件D类、技术E类和相应通则分别核对。资料对外提供与货物出境可能适用不同条目。
text.en: Check Category D software, Category E technology, and the corresponding general rules separately. Providing information abroad and physically exporting goods may fall under different entries.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 已在网上公开或公司内部共享就属于公共领域吗？
title.en: Does publication online or internal company sharing make information public domain?

summary.zh: 已在网上公开或公司内部共享就属于公共领域吗？
summary.en: Does publication online or internal company sharing make information public domain?

text.zh: 需符合清单定义：已经公开使用，并且可不受限制进一步扩大使用。公司内部共享通常不能仅凭“已分享”满足该定义；公共领域、基础研究等应逐案核实。
text.en: The List’s definition must be satisfied: publicly available and capable of further dissemination without restriction. Internal company sharing generally cannot satisfy the definition merely because the information has been “shared”; public-domain and basic-research status must be verified case by case.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 出口许可证是否自动覆盖全部技术？
title.en: Does an export license automatically cover all technology?

summary.zh: 出口许可证是否自动覆盖全部技术？
summary.en: Does an export license automatically cover all technology?

text.zh: 不覆盖全部技术。通则仅说明同一最终用户、该物项安装/运行/维护/修理所需最低限度技术随物项许可覆盖；研发或生产技术需另核对。
text.en: It does not cover all technology. The general rules only extend an item’s license to the minimum technology necessary for its installation, operation, maintenance, and repair for the same end user; development or production technology requires a separate review.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 进口和出口可以用同一个结论吗？
title.en: Can the same determination be used for imports and exports?

summary.zh: 进口和出口可以用同一个结论吗？
summary.en: Can the same determination be used for imports and exports?

text.zh: 不可以直接套用。先选方向，再查本方向栏目和条件；商用密码进口许可与信息安全出口管制等范围并不相同。
text.en: It cannot simply be carried over. First select the direction, then check that direction’s sections and conditions; the scope of commercial cryptography import licensing, for example, differs from information security export controls.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 普通带加密功能的家电或软件必然列管吗？
title.en: Are ordinary appliances or software with encryption necessarily controlled?

summary.zh: 普通带加密功能的家电或软件必然列管吗？
summary.en: Are ordinary appliances or software with encryption necessarily controlled?

text.zh: 不能仅凭“有加密”判断。核对5A002等条目的主要功能、算法/性能条件、软件条目及相关说明，并与进口密码栏目区分。
text.en: The presence of encryption alone is insufficient to decide. Check the principal functions, algorithm/performance conditions, software entries, and related notes under entries such as 5A002, and distinguish them from the cryptography import section.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 核出口栏目与第3位为2的核不扩散条目是一回事吗？
title.en: Is the nuclear export section the same as nuclear-nonproliferation entries with a third code character of 2?

summary.zh: 核出口栏目与第3位为2的核不扩散条目是一回事吗？
summary.en: Is the nuclear export section the same as nuclear-nonproliferation entries with a third code character of 2?

text.zh: 不是。前者为目录单列的核出口清单；后者是两用管制编码的管控原因。应在各自制度下识别，不强行合并编号。
text.en: No. The former is a separately listed nuclear export control list in the Catalog; the latter is a reason for control encoded in dual-use control codes. Identify items under their respective regimes; do not force the numbering systems together.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 监控化学品可以按一般两用物项流程办理吗？
title.en: Can scheduled chemicals follow the general dual-use application process?

summary.zh: 监控化学品可以按一般两用物项流程办理吗？
summary.en: Can scheduled chemicals follow the general dual-use application process?

text.zh: 应核对专门规则。1C450明确适用监控化学品管理条例及其补充执行安排；主管机关与申请路径不能机械套用一般条目。
text.en: Check the special rules. 1C450 expressly applies the Regulations on the Administration of Scheduled Chemicals and the supplementary implementation arrangements; do not mechanically apply the authority or application route for ordinary entries.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 常见化学品为什么出现在目录，是否所有国家都要办证？
title.en: Why are common chemicals listed, and do exports to every country require licenses?

summary.zh: 常见化学品为什么出现在目录，是否所有国家都要办证？
summary.en: Why are common chemicals listed, and do exports to every country require licenses?

text.zh: 先看易制毒子表。（一）与（二）（三）不同；后两表附特定目的地条件，必须连同脚注阅读。“等”不等于只列出的三个国家。
text.en: First check the drug-precursor subtable. Subsection (I) differs from (II) and (III); the latter two include specific destination conditions and must be read with their footnotes. “Including” does not mean only the three named countries.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 目录与清单说法不一致听哪个？
title.en: Which governs if the Catalog and Control List differ?

summary.zh: 目录与清单说法不一致听哪个？
summary.en: Which governs if the Catalog and Control List differ?

text.zh: 按目录说明第四项，以相关法律、行政法规、规章、两用物项清单及相关公告为准；核对公告生效日期，不按文件名称机械排优先级。
text.en: Under Catalog Explanatory Note IV, relevant laws, administrative regulations, rules, the Dual-Use Items Control List, and relevant announcements prevail; check announcement effective dates rather than assigning priority mechanically by document title.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 确定命中是否就一定可以获批出口？
title.en: Does a confirmed match guarantee export approval?

summary.zh: 确定命中是否就一定可以获批出口？
summary.en: Does a confirmed match guarantee export approval?

text.zh: 不是。还须审核目的地、最终用户/用途、管控名单和禁止性措施；有的交易不能仅靠申请一般许可解决。
text.en: No. Destination, end user/end use, control lists, and prohibitions still require review; some transactions cannot be addressed merely by applying for a standard license.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 技术指标不全，业务同事应交什么材料？
title.en: What should business colleagues provide if technical specifications are incomplete?

summary.zh: 技术指标不全，业务同事应交什么材料？
summary.en: What should business colleagues provide if technical specifications are incomplete?

text.zh: 先补齐产品型号/说明书、关键性能及测试依据、材料组成、主要用途、收货人和最终用户/用途。仍无法判断时，整理疑点向主管部门咨询。
text.en: First obtain the product model/manual, key performance specifications and test basis, material composition, principal uses, consignee, and end-user/end-use information. If the determination remains unclear, organize the questions and consult the competent authority.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 本表是截至今天全部出口管制措施吗？
title.en: Does this table cover every export control measure in force today?

summary.zh: 本表是截至今天全部出口管制措施吗？
summary.en: Does this table cover every export control measure in force today?

text.zh: 不是。本表完整整理两份上传附件，并单列外部时效提醒；目的地、实体名单、临时或专项措施仍须按交易日期核对最新公告。2026-03-31只是目录某项HS过渡截止日。
text.en: No. This table comprehensively organizes the two uploaded attachments and separately flags external time-sensitive measures; destination restrictions, entity lists, and temporary or special measures must still be checked against the latest announcements as of the transaction date. 2026-03-31 is only the deadline for a specific HS-code transition arrangement in the Catalog.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

text.zh: 70号公告暂停55、56、57、58、61、62号；本次整理时仍处其载明暂停期。勿把未生效/暂停项目直接并入当前附件明细；也不能推断所有稀土管制均暂停。
text.en: Announcement No. 70 suspends Announcements No. 55, 56, 57, 58, 61, and 62; the stated suspension period remains ongoing at the time of this compilation.
